title: The July jobs report, SpaceX earnings, and AI struggles: What to watch this week
title_zh: 7 月就业报告、SpaceX 盈利和人工智能困境：本周看点
summary: Investors step into another busy week, with the July jobs report and SpaceX earnings in focus.
summary_zh: 投资者又迎来了忙碌的一周，其中 7 月份就业报告和 SpaceX 盈利成为焦点。

title: Warsh’s Silent Treatment Has S&P Traders Bracing for Wild Swings
title_zh: 沃什的沉默对待让标普交易员做好了迎接剧烈波动的准备
summary: (Bloomberg) -- A relentless run of uncertainty, from war to tariff fights to inflation that refuses to die, has challenged investors this year.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——从战争到关税战，再到持续不断的通货膨胀，一系列的不确定性今年给投资者带来了挑战。

title: AI Isn’t a Catch-All Trade for Stocks in This Earnings Season
title_zh: 在这个财报季节，人工智能并不是股票的万能交易
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Equity investors are learning a harsh lesson this corporate earnings season: Not all artificial intelligence trades are created equal.Most Read from BloombergSingapore's Gated Island for the Rich Is Marred by Decayed HomesMoonshot’s Kimi Uses 20,000 Nvidia Chip ...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——在这个企业财报季，股票投资者正在吸取惨痛的教训：并非所有的人工智能交易都是平等的。彭博社的大多数报道《新加坡的富人之门岛因破烂的房屋而受损》Moonshot 的 Kimi 使用 20,000 个 Nvidia 芯片……

title: Will SpaceX paint its rocket pink? Investor questions go beyond Moon and Mars ahead of first results
title_zh: SpaceX 会将其火箭涂成粉红色吗？在第一批结果发布之前，投资者的问题超出了月球和火星的范围
summary: SpaceX's first earnings call as a public company may be expected to focus on AI spending and profits from its Starlink satellite communications network, but many retail investors have other ‌things on their minds.
summary_zh: SpaceX 作为上市公司的首次财报电话会议预计将重点关注人工智能支出和星链卫星通信网络的利润，但许多散户投资者还有其他想法。
